blocks.x: [The recording resumes on a new topic after a change of tape.]

He got some friends, or mutual friends, from Holland, who always send us flowers. They are here visiting for a short – for a few days. They want to go down to the thing tonight, but I never felt like it. I don’t like to go in a place by myself. I can’t very well any more, anyhow. So I’m going to have to call them and see if they can page him to come to the phone.
This is Bill Brower, interviewing Clark Terry for the Smithsonian Jazz Oral History Program on Tuesday, June the 22nd, 1999. I want to . . .
You think I should make that call first, or what?
Certainly. We can do that. Yeah.
But I’ve got to take my insulin, if that’s the case. Gwen! Gwen!
